title: Graphene oxide probe sorption explorer: interactive analysis of molecular-probe sorption on graphene oxide
description:
Interactive web application (Streamlit) for analysing the sorption of molecular probes on graphene oxide. It reproduces the analysis notebook Graphene_unified_analysis_filtered.ipynb on an editable dataset: substances and descriptors can be added, edited and excluded, and every plot, table and metric is recomputed.

Methods: k-means, hierarchical, spectral and DBSCAN clustering with internal validation metrics; sequential RANSAC correlations of sorption with Kamlet–Taft parameters (α, β, π*), Gutmann donor number, proton affinity and surface descriptors, with confidence bands; RANSAC planes; collinearity diagnostics (VIF, PCA); nested leave-one-out PLS with y-randomisation; conditional and full permutation tests with Benjamini–Hochberg correction. A vectorised RANSAC engine reproduces scikit-learn results exactly (verified against the notebook).

Interfaces: Russian (app.py) and English (app_en.py). Data: Graphene.xlsx. Code licensed under MIT; data under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA.md).
